	6.	Homocysteine (Hcy)
Hcy level is an independent risk  
factor for CVD, venous thrombotic 
disease, and other diseases; folic 
acid and vitamins B12 and B6 re-
duce plasma Hcy levels. Total Hcy 
(oxidized 1 reduced forms) is an 
intermediate amino acid in methio-
nine metabolism.
